name: Tsujii meitoku
source:
Third-year student. In charge of mixing (audio) in the band.
Comes across as cool and quiet, but emotionally resilient.
Has a go-at-your-own-pace attitude, unfazed by others.
Especially close to Hiroura and Shinosaki.
